instruction: Extract all text content from each slide in the presentation and compile it into a document named "output.docx" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting all text from PowerPoint to Word document. Evaluator performs comprehensive validation: (1) checks last line contains 'Share your screen' from final slide, (2) verifies minimum paragraph count of 10 to ensure multiple slides processed, (3) validates presence of key text snippets from different slides including title 'Unlocking the Power of ChatGPT', 'ChatGPT', and 'language model', (4) confirms first line is not empty. This multi-layered approach ensures complete text extraction from all slides.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator validates content from first slide (title), throughout presentation, and last slide using key text snippets
Multi-layered validation approach: Checks last line content, minimum paragraph count (10+), presence of 4 key snippets from different parts, and first line not empty
Correct semantic logic: Getter extracts all paragraphs into structured data, metric performs comprehensive validation on all aspects
Appropriate expected values: Key snippets ('Unlocking the Power of ChatGPT', 'ChatGPT', 'language model', 'Share your screen') are semantically correct for the specific presentation file
Proper postconfig: Activates output.docx window and saves with Ctrl+S to ensure fresh file state before validation
Correct parameter handling: Metric accesses expected.get('text') directly without incorrect expected.get('rules') pattern

validation.fix_description: Enhanced evaluator with comprehensive checks: (1) Getter now returns structured dict with all_text, paragraphs, paragraph_count, first_line, last_line instead of just last line. (2) Metric validates last line contains expected text, minimum 10 paragraphs extracted, presence of key snippets from multiple slides (title, ChatGPT, language model, Share your screen), and first line is not empty. This ensures ALL text from ALL slides is extracted, not just the last slide.
